column1: # Each kind of finding and the risk of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026) it is tagged
# with, as the reports print it. The mapping is Blindspot's own, not OWASP's. The codes and names
# come from OWASP's announcement of 9 December 2025 and its Q3 2026 exploit round-up (genai.owasp.org);
# docs/designs/owasp.md has the links and the reasons. One line each, tab separated. After editing,
#   kind      the field's name in fleet mode's JSON (machine.<field> for the Mac's own), or a name for
#             what only the person's report shows
#   risk      ASI01 to ASI10, or - when the kind is not a finding of any risk
#   name      the risk's name, the same on every line of that risk; - with no risk
#   label     what the fleet report lists under the risk, at most 32 characters; - with no risk
#   section   01 to 05, the report section the finding shows in; - for the Mac's own or no risk
#   source    a key of FL_KEYS in gird-fleet.sh (the account run's lines), incidents:act or
#             incidents:update for an incident of that level, machine:<field> for a field of the Mac's
#             own, or report for what only the person's report shows
#   why       with no risk only: why it carries none
# Every FL_KEYS key has one line (incidents two: incidents:act and incidents:update), so a new
# account-run field cannot ship without a decision on its risk.
